messages:
Asha Patel: Quick ask — can someone run a latency + cost pass for Llama-3-mini (7B-ish) on the xformer-optimized runtime? Need p50/p95 for seq len 128 and 1024, both fp16 and int8-q4. Goal is <120ms p95 for seq=128 and cost <= 0.7x our current replit-v2 profile. This will feed the onboarding doc. cc @Benji Kim @Maria Gomez

Benji Kim: On it. Do you want cold vs warm KV-cache numbers and batching? Also which artifact should I pull (HF converted path)? Any representative prompt set?

Asha Patel: Yes to cold vs warm. Batches: 1/4/16. Warm = after 8 tokens. Use hf-converted weights in gs://models/llama3-mini/converted/q4/ (same tokenization as hf/llama3). Prompt set: brief chat turns + one 512-token doc sample (will DM link).

Benji Kim: Got the bucket and prompt set. I'll run on a100-40 (dedicated) and t4 (hosted small) so we can compare. Will capture tokens/sec and cost-estimate for 1M tokens. ETA ~2 hours.

runtime-bench-bot: Bench queued — id=bench-1762314800-ll3 (platform: a100,t4; modes: fp16,int8-q4; seqs:128,1024; batches:1,4,16). Will post artifacts when finished.

Kai Stone: Heads up — if you see an unexpected slowdown on a100+int8, check the TVM kernel change from last Thursday (PR #492). Might need a rebuild of the int8 path.

Maria Gomez: Bench run finished. Summary below (attached artifacts: s3://bench-artifacts/1762314800/ — graphs + raw JSON). Quick highlights:

````
Model: Llama-3-mini (hf-converted)
Platform: a100-40 (dedicated) / t4-small (hosted)
Prompts: chat-short (avg 32 tokens), doc-512 (avg 512 tokens)

A100 (batch=1)
- seq=128 fp16: p50=18ms, p95=98ms, tokens/sec=320, est cost per 1M tokens=$9.2
- seq=128 int8-q4: p50=12ms, p95=110ms, tokens/sec=410, est cost per 1M tokens=$5.0
- seq=1024 fp16: p50=160ms, p95=480ms, tokens/sec=110, est cost per 1M tokens=$26
- seq=1024 int8-q4: p50=140ms, p95=620ms, tokens/sec=130, est cost per 1M tokens=$13

T4 (batch=1)
- seq=128 fp16: p50=28ms, p95=180ms, tokens/sec=210, est cost $14
- seq=128 int8-q4: p50=20ms, p95=240ms, tokens/sec=260, est cost $8
- seq=1024 fp16: p50=260ms, p95=900ms, tokens/sec=40
- seq=1024 int8-q4: p50=210ms, p95=1200ms, tokens/sec=50

Batching notes (a100): batch=4 improves tokens/sec ~3.6x for fp16; int8 shows ~3.9x but p95 increases a bit for long sequences. Cold vs warm: first token cold adds ~12-18ms on a100 int8.
````

Maria Gomez: Interpretation: A100 fp16 meets the 120ms p95 target for seq=128 (98ms). Int8 gives lower cost but slightly higher p95 tail. For seq=1024, latencies are high — recommend fp16 for latency-sensitive long-seq workloads. Compared to our replit-v2 perf profile, cost is ~0.65x for fp16 and ~0.48x for int8 on a100. T4 is cheaper infra but can hit large tails for long sequences.

Benji Kim: Nice work. I linked the raw traces + waterfall gifs in the PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1987 — includes perf profile JSON to add to the model catalog. I'll run a quick canary (small percentage) with fp16 first.

Asha Patel: This is perfect — thanks both. Action items: 1) Benji add model-catalog entry preferring fp16 for seq>512, recommend int8 for short-chat bursts; 2) Maria attach prompt set and regression test to the onboarding checklist; 3) Kai verify TVM int8 kernel if we see any a100 regression on next run.

Kai Stone: Will check TVM build when you start the canary.

Benji Kim: PR is up and canary scheduled for tomorrow morning. Will post results here. :rocket: :thumbsup:

Asha Patel: Awesome — marking this done for the onboarding doc prep. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
